glosses: North Central Vietnam form of ông; a grandfather or an old man
North Central Vietnam form of ông; you; he; him (refers to a man of middle age and above)

examples.text: Ôông khỏi lo! Chừ miềng đang phát triển thêm nghề phụ. Ôông biết đan lát, ôông lên mần tổ nghề phụ.
examples.translation: Don't worry! You're picking up a second trade now. You know how to knit, you're a master at the second trade.
